title: Rolling Bearing Fault Diagnosis Method Based on SWT and Improved Vision Transformer
summary: A wavelet/ViT method classified rolling-bearing faults under changing operating conditions and was checked on real wind-turbine bearing data.
ai_technology: SWT and ResCAA-ViT; Results include CWRU and real 1.5 MW wind-turbine data
organization: Key Laboratory of the Ministry of Education for Optoelectronic Measurement Technology and Instrument, Beijing Information Science and Technology University, Beijing 100192, China

evidence.tested: A wavelet/ViT method classified rolling-bearing faults under changing operating conditions and was checked on real wind-turbine bearing data.
evidence.unknown: The findings are limited to the reported dataset, experimental setup and validation described in the source; broader generalization and real-world benefit were not established.
